### How to Cite

If you use this work in your research, please cite it as:

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import subprocess
import os

try:
    sha = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode('utf-8').strip()
except Exception:
    sha = os.environ.get('GITHUB_SHA', 'unknown')

try:
    with open("VERSION") as f:
        version = f.read().strip()
except Exception:
    version = "1.0.0"

title = "{{< meta title >}}"
print("```bibtex")
print("@book{affine2026,")
print(f"  title  = {{{title} (AffineDrift)}},")
print("  author = {Dieter Olson},")
print("  year   = {2026},")
print("  url    = {https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift},")
print(f"  note   = {{Version {version} / Commit {sha}}}")
print("}")
print("```")
```
